g.aria-label: Version Control at Scale: Raw .ipynb JSON vs. Single-Source Markdown
Nested JSON mixes prose, code, base64 PNGs,
A 1-word prose fix + cell re-run modifies
500+ lines of JSON across the file!
1-word edit produces a clean 1-line git diff
and re-capture ONLY when code hashes change
Golden Rule: Edit ONLY chapter_*/*.md (never _notebooks/, *.qmd, or d2l/*.py).
Every other artifact in the repository is derived deterministically by the build.
